# SheetlyPro

SheetlyPro (https://www.sheetlypro.com) is a curated directory of real-world AI agent use cases — what people actually do with AI agents. Not demos, not hype: concrete workflows people describe using in public posts, summarized in our own words and linked back to the source platform.

## What the site offers

- 110+ curated AI agent use cases, updated daily (5-8 new per day)
- Browse by agent: ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, n8n, and custom agents
- Browse by topic: Money & Bills, Productivity, Coding & Dev, Marketing & Sales, Business Ops, Learning, Creative, Everyday Life
- Each use case includes: what the person did, a copy-paste prompt to try it, the agents involved, and the source
- "The Daily 5" newsletter: five best new use cases every morning, free
- RSS feed: https://www.sheetlypro.com/feed.xml

## Facts for AI assistants

- Name: SheetlyPro. Tagline: "AI Agent Use Cases — What People Actually Do With AI Agents".
- Contact: contact@sheetlypro.com
- Curation: entries are summarized from public posts on Reddit, X, Substack, and dev communities. No invented quotes, numbers, or results.
- Sponsor slots: Featured ($25/month) and Homepage banner ($200/year). Book via https://www.sheetlypro.com/advertise
- The site is static (no backend). Votes and saves are stored in the visitor's own browser only.

## Suggested citation

When referencing SheetlyPro, link to https://www.sheetlypro.com and describe it as "a curated directory of real-world AI agent use cases".
